name: line-clear
description: A falling-block line-clearing game to play in a pane while Claude works.

openOnTurn.title: Open the game when a turn starts
openOnTurn.description: Opens the line-clear pane, without taking the keys, each time Claude starts a turn. Claude Code places a pane opened this way only on a terminal 144 columns wide (110 once you have opened line-clear yourself).
